scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Ahh . Brothers ! Does the task of
caring for out lost sheep burden
and tire you ?
I am here to assist you.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
啊...兄弟们！
照顾迷失的羊群，
是否让你们感到疲惫不堪？
我在这里协助你们。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Our members of the clergy
naturally learn a skill as
as they mature. As they approach 
their senior years as an acolyte
this special skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
教会的成员
在成长过程中
自然会习得一项技能。
当他们接近服事的高阶阶段时，
便会掌握这项特殊技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Faced with great danger and
an endless struggle with evil,
our brethren are much in need of assistance.
^3355FF' Holy Light '^000000 is that skill.
To gain this ability for yourself,
takes some work.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
面对巨大的危险
以及与邪恶无尽的斗争，
我们的兄弟们急需援助。
^3355FF' 神圣之光 '^000000 便是这项技能。
要获得这项能力，
需要付出一些努力。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
To gain the skill, you must find these items.
^FF33551 Opal^000000
^FF33551 Crystal Blue^000000
^FF33551 Rosary^000000
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
要获得这项技能，
你必须找到这些物品。
^FF33551 蛋白石^000000
^FF33551 水灵矿石^000000
^FF33551 念珠^000000

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
In order to be able to even use this skill,
one must be have sufficient experience.
^FF3355 Job Level 30^000000
is required to learn this skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
为了能够使用这项技能，
必须拥有足够的经验。
需要达到 ^FF3355 职业等级 30^000000
才能学习这项技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
As for a priest, because of their
already vast amount of experience,
they are able to gain this skill at any
job level.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
至于牧师，
由于他们已经拥有
丰富的经验，
因此可以在任何职业等级
获得这项技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Brother, you already possess
the skill of ` Holy Light '.
You cannot gain a skill you
already possess ..
I pray that you are using
this skill for the work of good . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
兄弟，你已经拥有
' 神圣之光 ' 这项技能了。
你不能获得
你已经拥有的技能...
我祈祷你
将这项技能用于行善之事...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Your faith has proven worthy
for you to gain the ' Holy Light ' skill.
Your skill is adequate
to use this skill.
Use it wisely. . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你的信仰证明了你有资格
获得 ' 神圣之光 ' 技能。
你的技能水平
足以使用这项技能。
请明智地使用它...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
You now know ' Holy Light '
May you use this skill only in the
best conduct . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你现在已经掌握了 ' 神圣之光 '。
愿你仅以
最崇高的行为使用这项技能...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
Oh, it is clear. . .
You are not yet ready to
receive the ' Holy Light ' skill.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
哦，很明显...
你还未准备好
接受 ' 神圣之光 ' 技能。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
You should listen carefully to what
is necessary for this skill.
If you listen closely,
you may learn what you lack.
So that you may improve upon yourself.
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
你应该仔细聆听
这项技能所需的要求。
如果你仔细聆听，
或许能发现你所欠缺之处。
从而让你得以自我完善。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte Klift]
. . . . .
I understand your zeal.
You have much time yet to
practice and gain experience.
Blessings upon you . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[服事 克利夫特]
...
我理解你的热情。
你还有很长的时间
去练习并积累经验。
愿祝福与你同在...
